name: Seekadu — Instagram DM → reservation agents
what_it_does: Turns Instagram Reels comments / story replies / DMs into in-thread reservation flows synced to OpenTable/Resy/SevenRooms; WhatsApp booking too.
how_competitors_use_it: Social signal → covers booked. Adjacent to social GTM but closes on reservations, not shoppable buy-now.
what_we_use_today: Restaurant Scout love→buy-now scripts + pain shoppers; no reservation-DM product.
gap: Do not confuse Seekadu’s booking close with Never86 commerce close — keep scripts purchase-path.
summary: Watch as social-conversion rival; Never86 edge stays SKU buy-now / anti-marketplace, not table turns.
